labels.zh-CN: GPX 或 GeoJSON 线路文件

details.formulaDescription: Parse only line geometry. GPX trkseg and rte elements become independent segments; GeoJSON LineString, MultiLineString and FeatureCollection or Feature wrappers containing only those types are accepted. Serialize the ordered coordinates to the target format, writing elevation only when a point has it. The output contains no timestamps, device names, person names or original metadata.
assumptions: Input coordinates are WGS84 longitude and latitude in that order.
Only line geometry is accepted; points, polygons and other geometry types are rejected rather than silently discarded.
Distance is the WGS84 geodesic distance between consecutive points and is informational, not a certified course measurement.
Conversion re-serializes the geometry, so the output is not byte-identical to the original even when the format is unchanged.
Missing elevation stays missing; it is never written as zero.
Input files are limited to 20 MB and 200,000 coordinate points; larger files are rejected before processing.
details.rounding: Coordinates and elevation values are preserved as parsed; distance is reported to the nearest whole metre; file size is reported in bytes, with binary-friendly units only for display.
